what: Plan treats revise failure as non-zero rc, but helper reports failed revisions via REVISE_STATUS while exiting 0
scenario_or_breakage: A failed/no-patch waterfall is interpreted as success, PLAN_HASH_AFTER_REVISE stays equal, accepted findings are not applied, and the loop can converge or cap-hit with silently unapplied findings
suggested_fix: Parse revise stdout, require REVISE_STATUS=ok for success, branch revision-failed on any failed-* status, and add a regression where the helper exits 0 with REVISE_STATUS=failed-no-patch

what: Plan disallows plan-review/round-N/revise while the revise helper writes there
scenario_or_breakage: Any successful auto-apply creates plan-review/round-N/revise artifacts, then design-log-publish fail-closes on the unexpected nested path during final publish
suggested_fix: Either update revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh and its md/tests to write under DESIGN_TMPDIR/revise/round-N, or allow a constrained round-N/revise allowlist in design-log-publish and document it

what: Accepted OOS artifacts are overwritten each internal round with no cross-round merge
scenario_or_breakage: OOS accepted in round 1 disappears when round 2 rewrites oos-accepted-design.md, so Step 5b never files that accepted issue
suggested_fix: Define and test a cross-round OOS union artifact, dedupe OOS IDs across rounds, and make Step 5b consume the union after the loop

what: Proposed stale-round cleanup uses rm -rf through an unchecked plan-review path
scenario_or_breakage: If DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review is a symlink or swapped path, rm -rf "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review/round-"* can delete round-* paths outside the session tree
suggested_fix: Before cleanup, reject symlink/non-directory plan-review paths, resolve the physical root, and delete only validated child directories under that root

what: Round summary schema omits fields Gate B is supposed to derive from it
scenario_or_breakage: Passive-summary mode promises per-round LOOP_STATUS, but round-summary.env lacks LOOP_STATUS/REASON/REVISE_STATUS and may record pre-failure DEGRADED_PANEL values
suggested_fix: Add LOOP_STATUS, REASON, CONVERGENCE_STREAK, REVISE_STATUS, and revise tier/status fields to round-summary.env; write the final per-round state after revision outcome is known

what: Round-cap defaults and single-pass compatibility are internally inconsistent
scenario_or_breakage: One part says --round-cap defaults to LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP, another says omitted --round-cap defaults to --round-num; existing callers may unexpectedly run multiple rounds or auto-revise when they expected a single complete pass
suggested_fix: Add an explicit ROUND_CAP_ARG_SEEN/single_pass_mode contract: omitted --round-cap ignores env and preserves old complete/no-auto-loop behavior, while SKILL.md passes explicit production caps
